lines.text: AMC ten challenge! Think it's three hundred eighty-four? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 10 challenge! Think it's 384? Nope!

lines.text: Nine lights in a three by three grid, each on or off.
lines.caption: 9 lights in a 3 by 3 grid, each on or off.

lines.text: How many patterns have at least one full row or column all lit?
lines.caption: How many patterns have at least one full row or column all lit?

lines.text: Count the losers: no full row or column.
lines.caption: Count the losers: no full row or column.

lines.text: Each row has seven safe choices. So seven cubed: three hundred forty-three.
lines.caption: Each row has 7 safe choices. So 7 cubed: 343.

lines.text: Seventy-eight of those still have a full column. That leaves two hundred sixty-five losers.
lines.caption: 78 of those still have a full column. That leaves 265 losers.

lines.text: All five hundred twelve, minus the losers, is two hundred forty-seven!
lines.caption: All 512, minus the losers, is 247!

lines.text: Three hundred eighty-four was the trap. It counts this one twice!
lines.caption: 384 was the trap. It counts this one twice!

lines.text: Did you get two hundred forty-seven? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 247? Tell me below!
